intention: STONE 3 of the chart device: /moreabout v0 — THE LEARNING DOOR, the skill pair's other half (chart-tree filed edge (a)). When a packet field (or any deposited learning) is too compressed, /moreabout <ask> resolves the expansion FROM DEPOSITED STATE — a counsel walk over the upstream nexus's own tree, with walked nodes' berthed packets attached when their provenance names a file on disk — NEVER a re-run of the upstream pass (charter falsifier 4). And the invocation ITSELF is the training signal: the same command writes the ask back to that nexus's tree as a dated moreabout_signal node ('this, at this compression, wasn't enough for this class'), one embed serving both the walk and the write-back. The door serves every tenant of the generalized verbs — chart's nexi, orient's corrections, the inspector's failures — through the same mouth.
why: The parent's why, verbatim half: '...learning from /moreabout <something>'. Until this door exists the trees the grafts populated are write-mostly — counsel works but nothing in the standing workflow INVOKES a walk instead of silently re-reading a too-compressed field; the training signal has no mouth. And the floor-tuning edge (chart-tree edge (d)) needs routine measured walks: the n=3 floor evidence (0.7707 / 0.6780 over, 0.5775 correct-but-under, 2026-07-28) was hand-fired; every /moreabout crossing is a real-need counsel measurement. The under-floor lesson is DESIGN INPUT here: ranking has been measured right under the floor, so the door surfaces under-floor walks honestly (top nodes shown, labeled under-floor) instead of laundering 'under floor' into 'nothing known'.
traces_to: Law 1 — a too-compressed field resolves from structure (the walk), never by re-running the pass that compressed it; the signal compiles the recurrence into evidence
Law 3 — every invocation is a measured walk (similarity vs the labeled floor) and a dated signal — the parsimony threshold tunes on data, not vibes
Law 4 — the no-re-run rule is import physics: moreabout.py's AST allowlist cannot reach the floor/ceiling machinery, so a re-run is structurally impossible, not discouraged
Law 6 — the door reaches each tenant's tree only through chart's owner-generalized verbs, db_domain's same gate; no second door
Law 7 — an under-floor walk is reported labeled, never collapsed to empty; an unreadable berth is named, never fabricated

falsifier.horizon: re-read when signals accumulate enough to adjust a parsimony threshold (the charter's how_it_learns (2) becoming live); when chart-tree edge (b) fires (per-field nodes — /moreabout is the named consumer that earns that grain); when edge (d)'s floor move is proposed (this door's walks are the evidence stream); when a second stage lands (constrain — /moreabout must serve its tree unchanged).

questions.a: THE INVOCATION IS THE SIGNAL, NOT A SEPARATE ACT: one live verb does walk + write-back with one embed — an opt-in signal would be skipped exactly when the honest datum is least flattering.

SIGNAL CONTENT IS THE ASK ITSELF; a repeat identical ask returns duplicate:true — the dedup is not lost frequency, it is frequency made readable at invoke time (v0, build-minimal; per-class counters grow against need).

UNDER-FLOOR HONESTY AS A TOOTH: a walk whose every node sits under the floor still returns the ranked nodes, flagged under_floor with the floor visible — because ranking was measured right (correct node first) at 0.5775 < 0.65 the day this was cast.

BERTHED STATE ATTACHES ONLY WHAT EXISTS: a provenance source that is a file on disk attaches parsed; a non-file source passes through untouched (orient's scars name sessions, not files); an unreadable file is named loudly — three honest shapes, no fabrication.
